_note: Generic 3-axis vertical mill, Fanuc-style control. Distances in mm, work offset G54 Z0 on top of the part. rapid_rate (mm/min), tool_change_seconds and peck_clearance (how far above the last peck the drill comes back down) are typical values used for the simulation and cycle time, not measured on a real machine. drill_oversize (mm) is how much bigger than its size a twist drill can cut; a hole whose upper tolerance is tighter than that is reamed.
name: Generic VMC
